# CommandResponse

`schemas/api/command-response.json`

The response to a command, a union on disposition [M13] (docs/design/m0/08): applied, proposed (waiting for a confirmation) or refused. The CLI's exit code follows it: 0 applied, 3 proposed, 1 refused, 2 could_not_run, 4 a stale refusal.

A document is one of: [CommandApplied](#commandapplied) or [CommandProposed](#commandproposed) or [CommandRefused](#commandrefused).

## Definitions

### CommandApplied

The command ran: its events, the approval it made (an authority-gated action) and its effects in their current states. A replay of an accepted command returns the same, with replayed set.

| `last_seq` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |

| `issued_credential` |  | string (pattern `^tok_[0-7][0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{25}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{42}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]$`) | A bearer string, tok_&lt;id&gt;.&lt;secret&gt;, that the command issued (14 N3): present only on the response that applied it, absent on a replay. It is never stored. Where the CLI keeps it is for 14 7a/7b to decide; until then the CLI refuses it (could_not_run) and never prints or writes it. |

### CommandProposed

The command needs a confirmation (04 "Proposals"): nothing was applied. A human policy is confirmed only on the dashboard (D37).

#### Fields of CommandProposed

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disposition` | yes | `proposed` |  |
| `proposal` | yes | [ProposalID](common-defs.md#proposalid) |  |
| `policy` | yes | one of `independent_review`, `human` |  |
| `binding_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### CommandRefused

Nothing was applied: failed (the command was decided and refused) or could_not_run (the controller or a dependency could not run it).

#### Fields of CommandRefused

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disposition` | yes | `refused` |  |
| `outcome` | yes | one of `failed`, `could_not_run` |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) |  |
| `detail` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `4096`) | Never empty for these outcomes (02). Whether the reason is registered for the outcome is the vocabulary's check (internal/vocab Registry.Check), run where the response is written and where it is read. |

No other fields are allowed.
